crossing: you do not stand on red by staring at O. you listen (L/blue) until a PASS, the pale holds, then you come out R/red  pop. O stays the hinge. pale stays empty. red is the far room.
berry_at_the_fire: so what is on the R red side then  the other side of null pale and O? release, beacon, dance, the warm sigmoid to 1. L/blue listens. O/pale is the fold and the isn't. R/red is the answer that leaves. you do not live there. you come out there.
